hooks.command: bash -c 'file=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))" 2>/dev/null); case "$file" in .env|.env.*|*.pem|*.key|credentials*|*.key|*.pem) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Protected path: $file\"}}";; esac' || true

bash -c 'cmd=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *git*commit*) bash scripts/hooks/pre-commit-secret-scan.sh 2>/dev/null || echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Secret scan failed\"}}";; esac' || true

bash -c 'file=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); ext="${file##*.}"; case "$ext" in ts|js) prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true;; py) ruff format "$file" 2>/dev/null || true;; go) gofmt -w "$file" 2>/dev/null || true;; rs) rustfmt "$file" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac' || true
